03-27-1186 is March 27, 1186.  
Subtract 180 days:  
March 27 back 27 days → March 1 (27 days back).  
Remaining 180 - 27 = 153 days earlier.  
February 1186 had 28 days (1186 not divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but same leap year rule for simplicity).  
January 31 days, December 31 days, November 30 days, October 31 days, September 30 days.  
Count back: March 1 → Feb 1 (28 days back) → Jan 1 (29 more days, total 57) → Dec 1 (31 more, total 88) → Nov 1 (30 more, total 118) → Oct 1 (31 more, total 149).  
153 total: at Oct 1 we’ve gone back 149 days, need 4 more days back → Sept 27, 1185.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1185-09-27
